cs.t: I've had that "I should just use my laptop" moment many, many times. There are lots of things the iPad is objectively worse at than my very nice X1 Carbon running Arch. And yet I keep coming back to my iPad pro. I can't put my finger on what it is but I think it's some combination of: 1. Gorgeous high resolution, high refresh rate, generally pretty screen. 2. Long battery life. 3. Instant wake. 4. Ruggedness. Even with solid-state everything I'm always a little wary of chucking my laptop into the passenger seat of a car, taking it near sand or dust, etc. There's fan vents and hinges and... stuff. The iPad Pro in a Logitech Folio case has all the corners protected from drops, no airflow, few holes. I just don't worry about it. 5. Pencil. The handwritten notes experience has gotten really good. Being able to flick into that mode any time is nice.
